question: The 'Arya Samaj' was founded in 1875 by:
solution:
The correct answer is** __Swami Dayanand Saraswati.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• Swami Dayanand Saraswati
 
 
• Dayanand Sarasvati started the powerful modern Hindu reform movement known as Arya samaj (sanskrit:''society of nobbles'')in 1875 with the goal of restoring the Vedas, the earliest Hindu scriptures as revealed truth.
 
• Arya samaj is a Monotheistic Indian Hindu reform movement that upholds principal and behaviours based on the conviction that the vedas are Infallible.
 
• Indian philosopher Maharshi Dayanand saraswati founded the arya samaj, a vedic dharma reform organisation and was also a social reformer .
 
• ​In 1876 he was the first to make the plea for sawaraj as ''India for Indians'' which lokmanya tilak eventually embraced.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Ishwar chandra Vidhyasagar
 
 
• Ishwar chandra Vidhyasagar was a nineteenth-century Indian Educator and Social reformer. He made a lot of effort to Modernise and streamline Bengali literature
 
 
 
• Swami vivekananda
 
 
• Swami vivekananda was a Hindu monk, Philosopher and Writer from india. He was the foremost pupil of the Indian Spiritual Ramakrishna.
 
• ​He was a key player in introducing the indian darsanas of vedanta and yoga to the western world.
 
 
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy
 
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was an indian reformer who was one of the Brahmo sabha's founders in 1828.
 
• The Brahmo sabha was the forerunner of the Brahmo samaj, an Organisation that Promoted social and religious change in the Indian Subcontinent.
